notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone for this months update we are finally ready to publish a really massive update for the demo. We have been hard at work with a multitude of bug fixes and everyone will get a preview of one the dinosaurs from the next area of the game as well! 

Patch Notes:
-Added preview of Coelophysis in main venue
-Fixed detection issues with certain items
-Map displays and med cabinets have been updated 
-Radio lines will now que instead of cutting off
-Fix soft lock issue in tutorial
-Performance improvements 
-Various AI fixes and overhaul 
-MANY other bug fixes

Were currently exploring some audio issues in regards to AI which means there may be a future patch fixing those too. 

In the meantime we are still quite hard at work on the next big area of the game, we hope to have more to show everyone in the near future. Stay posted!

notes.title: Post Kickstarter Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Things have been hectic but our Kickstarter ended in a huge success! We surpassed our goal at the end of September and have had our heads down for a little while now working on the game. 

In the past we havent been terribly great with providing updates on the steam side of things, and we want to rectify that going forward. 

So whats been going on? For starters were busy working on the second of four major sections of the game. You will have likely already played through the first major section of the game called Arrival in our demo. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41506501/fdb002b8861f2671719ac7f2ed853c5fcc8909d3.png[/img]

We also have been working on some new creatures for the player to encounter:

[previewyoutube=95BgroMKiIY;full][/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=CkS3xNHVB_4;full][/previewyoutube]

Thats all for now everyone, we hope to have more exciting news down the line for you!

notes.title: Athanasia First Patch Out Now!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We are happy to announce our first major patch to the demo which should address some issues players encountered. If this is your first time or you are returning to the demo, now is the time hop on again and try the demo out! 

Full patch notes here: 

-Bug fixes
-Major performance boost
-Improvements to item placement and game balance
-Fixed issues with mantling to make it more consistent
-Updated computers so which ones can be sabotaged is more clear
-Players can now manipulate items as well
-Audio improvements
-Crossbow steel bolt damage increased 
-Updated some of our tutorials
-Improved our decal system
-Improved our fire system
-Increased player sprint
-More lore emails
-Minor improvements
